question_text: A room-temperature controller polls its sensor. Temperature changes slowly relative to one second. Outline a reason to poll every minute rather than every second.
adaptation_rationale: Retains sampling-frequency trade off within explicitly listed polling event frequency/overhead scope.
solution: Fewer polls reduce processor/communication overhead.; If that interval still detects changes quickly enough for the application, the extra polls provide little useful control benefit.
